facts.business: Binny Mills Limited is a textile company engaged in manufacturing and retail operations with showrooms in Bangalore and works in Perambur, Chennai.

auditor.name: Ramesh & Ramachandran
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter on: (1) Loan to related party extended by 3 years with additional Rs 1.50 crore granted, no impairment provision made; (2) Demerger-related pending litigations liability not quantified; (3) Rs 9.73 crore paid on behalf of parent Binny Ltd, fully provided for; (4) Rent dispute with Square Project Associates dismissed but Rs 28.05 lakh provision retained; (5) Labour court case decided against company for 8 of 10 employees, Rs 36.52 lakh provision made.

key_risks: Related party loan exposure with extended tenure and additional lending
Unquantified litigation liabilities from demerger scheme
Recoverability of Rs 9.73 crore paid on behalf of parent company
Ongoing rent dispute provisions despite court dismissal
Labour court adverse rulings with stay filed
facts.related_party_note: Note No. 6: Loan granted to related party, tenure extended by 3 years, additional Rs 1.50 crore granted during year, accounted at amortised cost per Ind AS 109, no impairment provision made based on positive net worth of related party.
